_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.95x; +51% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.53; conservative 2yr -2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.0%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.4%/yr (Q2 2012 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.2%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2012-08-31) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.95x (64.6% downside to Bear $43 / +21.9% upside to Bull $148) | Adj composite 2.34 vs market 2.87: gap -0.53 [OVERVALUED] | +51% above the EPP floor $81 (12x FY12E $6.72) | Conservative 2-yr case: -2.0% total (-1.0%/yr) | At 18.1x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $161 sits above the BULL case; carloads +0% in Q2 2012, forward revenue +7% (no FY12 revenue guide, Q2 2012 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2011 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2007-2011 (diluted EPS 2007 $3.44, 2008 $4.53, 2009 $3.74, 2010 $5.53, 2011 $6.72; 2011 operating ratio 70.7%); 2011 diluted shares 489.8M, effective tax rate 37.5%, interest expense $572M, other income $112M, free cash flow $1,917M; 15,340,810 shares repurchased in 2011; 2012 Outlook in words only (volume growth that will exceed 2011 levels, earnings that exceed 2011 earnings); capital investments of about $3.6 billion

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2006 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2002-2006 (operating revenue, diluted EPS from continuing operations, operating margin and ratio, carloads); 2006 diluted shares 272.0M, effective tax rate 36.4%, interest expense $477M, other income $118M; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2007 Outlook: commodity revenue growth target 6% to 7%, volume growth 2% to 3%, earnings growth of 10% to 15% and an operating ratio below 80%; quarterly dividend raised to $0.35 on 2007-01-30; 20M-share repurchase authorized 2007-01-30 through 2009
